entries.title: A check you approved stays approved when its words come back
entries.body: When you approve what a check uses and what one run costs, a crewmate that later rewords those lines and then puts your exact words back can run the check again without asking you a second time. Your approval never comes back if you said no to the same words later.
entries.noPicture: This changes which recorded approvals a check run may use, not a view or control.
